:::{#exr-matrix-equality-practice}
#### Solving for an unknown entry

Two [matrices](#def-matrix) are [equal](#def-matrix-equality) only when every pair of matching entries agrees,
so one matrix equation stands for several equations between numbers.
Let

$$
\begin{bmatrix} 2 & x + 1 \\ 0 & 5 \end{bmatrix}
= \begin{bmatrix} 2 & 4 \\ 0 & 5 \end{bmatrix}.
$$

Find $x$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Both [matrices](#def-matrix) are $2 \times 2$,
so by @def-matrix-equality each entry on the left is the same number as the entry in the same position on the right.

:::
